title: Grasp selection from a depth image
summary: Candidate grasps on a depth image are ranked by the planarity of the surface patch under each fingertip and by the distance from the grasp to the centroid of the segmented object.

claims.text: A method of selecting a grasp, comprising ranking candidate grasps on a depth image by the planarity of the surface patch under each fingertip and by the distance from the grasp to the centroid of the segmented object.
The method of claim 1, wherein the planarity is the residual of a plane fitted to the patch.
